detail_text: ArtworkU.S. Army Health Clinic Baumholder, GermanyU.S. Army Health Clinic Wiesbaden, GermanyThis is a sources-sought announcement only for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. The Government will not pay for any information or reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this RFI. No solicitation is being issued at this time. The Government is seeking interested contractors for a contract or delivery order to provide artwork for Baumholder Health and Dental Clinic and Wiesbaden Health Clinic under separate contract actions. It is anticipated all artwork will be shipped to Landstuhl Regional Medical Center, located in Landstuhl Germany, and installed by others.
